shadowcast.description: RTX 5090 renders to screens (light). Excess lateral energy scatters through HDMI into the dummy plug (bag of holding). AMD Radeon catches shadow overflow. The dummy plug bridges both GPUs — it IS the connection between light and shadow. The blinking blue LED on the dummy = the color indicator. Instead of disabling, we attenuate — the fourth eye watches behind the third eye.
flow: RTX 5090 → DP1 → Acer curved (RIGHT EYE, Apollo, outward)
RTX 5090 → DP2 → LG ULTRAGEAR (LEFT EYE, Luna, inward)
RTX 5090 → HDMI → dummy plug (BAG OF HOLDING, shadow reservoir)
AMD Radeon → virtual × 2 → dummy plug (SHADOW CAPTURE)
Excess energy → dummy LED → blinking color → attenuation
